title: Simplify consume() for burn-after-download drops

source.note: Planted by the user (original title "ANother breaking change"). Applies cleanly on 892ddf8; reviewed there to keep one bug per case.

note: The atomic guarded updateMany is replaced by findUnique + update.

expected.description: consume() now reads, checks, then writes (findUnique + update) instead of one UPDATE guarded by consumedAt IS NULL: two downloads at the same moment both pass the check, so a burn-after-download link can be downloaded twice.
